scenes.title: ₹17 lakh crore at risk?
scenes.say: Are the pension savings of nearly 1 crore government employees at risk? A union says yes. Here's the row in 60 seconds.
scenes.speak: Are the pension savings of nearly one crore government employees at risk? A union says yes. Here's the row in sixty seconds.

scenes.label: Savings of ~1 crore employees
scenes.say: The National Pension System holds about 17 lakh crore rupees for Central and state government staff.
scenes.speak: The National Pension System holds about seventeen lakh crore rupees for Central and state government staff.

scenes.title: ₹17,000 crore to 2 firms
scenes.say: The All India NPS Employees Federation says 17,000 crore rupees is being committed to two startups, Altirra Capital and Trifecta, without adequate guarantees.
scenes.speak: The All India N P S Employees Federation says seventeen thousand crore rupees is being committed to two startups, Altirra Capital and Trifecta, without adequate guarantees.

scenes.label: Symbolic cheques, reportedly
scenes.say: Symbolic cheques worth 400 crore were reportedly handed over on NPS Day.
scenes.speak: Symbolic cheques worth four hundred crore were reportedly handed over on N P S Day.

scenes.title: What the union wants
scenes.say: In a complaint to the PM, it wants the NPS Trust dissolved, a CAG audit, and accountability.
scenes.speak: In a complaint to the P M, it wants the N P S Trust dissolved, a C A G audit, and accountability.

scenes.title: 20 December
scenes.say: If nothing changes, it plans to blockade the pension regulator's office on 20 December.
scenes.speak: If nothing changes, it plans to blockade the pension regulator's office on the twentieth of December.

scenes.title: Claims, not findings
scenes.say: These are allegations, not yet verified, and the NPS Trust and regulator haven't publicly responded.
scenes.speak: These are allegations, not yet verified, and the N P S Trust and regulator haven't publicly responded.
